cross_component_finding: This page states explicitly that 'index' is not a single unified concept across Couchbase Server: the Query service consumes indexes built by the separate Index service, while the Search and Analytics services each maintain their own internal index types. Any ontology node for 'index' should probably be a supertype with service-specific subtypes (GSI/primary via Index service, Full Text via Search service, Analytics index via Analytics service, View via the deprecated view engine), since privilege/version/edition facts likely attach at the subtype level, not this shared label.
